# Bundled spreadsheet parser

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 is bundled locally as `xlsx.full.min.js`.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

License: Apache 2.0, included in LICENSE-SheetJS.txt.

The extension loads this local copy without a CDN request. Workbook data is parsed in the extension tab.
